import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 3

def design(feats):
    # Filter for significant features (p < 0.05)
    sig_idx = [i for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) 
               if abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,i][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,i][feats.y==0]).statistic) > 2.0]
    
    if not sig_idx:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_mat = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,sig_idx].T)
    
    # Cluster features based on correlation
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2, linkage='average').fit(corr_mat)
    
    # Select cluster with highest mean effect size
    clusters = {}
    for i, label in enumerate(clustering.labels_):
        if label not in clusters:
            clusters[label] = []
        clusters[label].append(sig_idx[i])
    
    # Get cluster with most significant features
    best_cluster = max(clusters.values(), key=lambda x: np.mean([abs(stats.ttest_ind(
        feats.x[:,i][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,i][feats.y==0]).statistic) for i in x]))
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlation > 0.6)
    unique_features = []
    for i, fid in enumerate([feats.ids[j] for j in best_cluster]):
        is_unique = True
        for existing_fid in unique_features:
            idx1 = feats.column(existing_fid)
            idx2 = feats.column(fid)
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,idx1], feats.x[:,idx2])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_unique = False
                break
        if is_unique:
            unique_features.append(fid)
    
    # Use top 3 features as drivers
    drivers = tuple(unique_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Create weighted score from all features
    weights = {}
    for fid in unique_features:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,idx][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,idx][feats.y==0]).statistic
        weights[fid] = abs(t_stat) / len(unique_features)
    
    # Return design
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=unique_features, products=(), loadings=weights)
